entry.title: mflux
entry.summary:
MFLUX: MLX Native Generative Image Models
The Problem
Everyone wants to run fancy generative image models locally, but most repos assume you love Python environments more than your sanity. Dependency hell, GPU compatibility issues, and bloated libraries are often the norm. Hugging Face’s diffusers and transformers are great—but they’re huge, and they’re not optimized for local MLX workflows. That’s where mflux steps in.
